positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I'm a full stack engineer. I design and implement custom solutions to complex problems for diverse clients. My job oscillates between being heads down one large project, and contributing in every way imaginable to many others. I also do a lot of in house training on topics like AngularJS, JavaScript, and Agile.

We use many different technologies, but a common core is:
C#, ASP.NET, MS SQL, IIS, WCF, REST, HTML 5, JavaScript, and CSS3

positions.title: Software Engineer

I developed cutting edge web applications used by sales users to provide quotes to potential and current customers.
